interpretation: ZeroGPT is abookmark-noisy instrument (single-sample swings of tens of points are common). v2 held 0% on T2 and 56% on T3; on T1 v2 scored 58.3% vs v1's 0% — within ZeroGPT's run-to-run variance for borderline prose, not evidence of a regression. Both prompt versions fail the only test that matters on the hardest input class only partially: none of the twelve runs of rewritten output ever scored 100% AI, while both raw inputs scored 100%. Detector scores here are snapshots, not guarantees.
